coordinate_system.bounds: [x0,y0,x1,y1] in [0,1]; operations apply sequentially to the current image

policy: Every transform is pinned to the verified source SHA-256.
Generated derivatives are candidates until separately visually reviewed.
Do not auto-approve a transform merely because it removes known text regions.
Masks must not overlap architecture evidence.

transforms.rationale: Remove the entire branded lower strip while retaining the complete head, torso, shoulders, both ball-jointed arms/hands, waist interface, and enough lower-body context for scale. The evaluation target is the custom upper-body architecture, so this crop does not remove target geometry.

revision_history.reason: The initial border-median fill removed the logo but introduced a conspicuous flat rectangular patch that failed the no-material-transform-artifacts review check.

Row-median background reconstruction removed the logo but left visible horizontal banding and a patch boundary, failing the no-material-transform-artifacts check. A clean crop is preferable because the required view explicitly permits complete upper-body architecture.
